entities.summary: Phùng Khắc Khoan (1528–1613), courtesy name Hoằng Phu, pen name Nghị Trai, Mai Nham Tử, known as Trạng Bùng, was a noted 16th-century Vietnamese military strategist, politician, diplomat and poet during the Later Lê dynasty warlord period.
